frames.title: Hotel Desk, Dosa Going Cold
frames.narration: Yesterday evening, Anurag stared at an unfinished Skills API presentation while a dosa cooled beside his laptop. Slack pings about the ADE dinner kept appearing, and he had to decide what to do first.

frames.title: Slide Panic Spiral
frames.narration: Architecture diagrams, speaker notes, and last-minute edits piled up. The more he tried to perfect every slide, the less progress he felt.

frames.title: Hallway Reset
frames.narration: He stepped into the hallway to breathe, phone in hand, reading the ADE dinner thread. He could still choose connection over panic.

frames.title: Empty Hotel Grind
frames.narration: He stayed back, skipped dinner, and kept forcing slides alone. The room got quieter, but the work did not get clearer.

frames.title: ADE Dinner Decision
frames.narration: He went to the ADE dinner. The table was lively, the food was great, and for the first time that day he stopped spiraling.

frames.title: Back Late, Clock at 11:47 PM
frames.narration: Back at the hotel, the stress returned instantly: not enough slides, not enough time. Now the decision had to be smarter, not louder.

frames.title: Early Return, Same Block
frames.narration: Even leaving dinner early did not fix the core issue. He still had a half-built deck and a ticking clock.

frames.title: Ending: Brute Force Night
frames.narration: He pushed manually into the night, exhausted and unhappy. The deck was barely done, and the process took a heavy toll.

frames.title: Ending: Codex + Minh Skill Save
frames.narration: He launched a Codex task with Minh's slide skill, and the deck assembled automatically. Panic turned into relief, and he finally slept with confidence.

frames.title: Ending: Missed Momentum
frames.narration: He shut the laptop without a real plan and hoped tomorrow would sort itself out. The stress was postponed, not solved.
